entries:
Alpha 1.34.0 (safer item drops)

  • Drop the stack you inspected: Dragging items out of your bag now checks that the quantity has not changed. Changed stacks are rejected without removing items; inspect the stack and try again.
  • Time to pick it up: Older ground-loot creation paths now give items their full one-minute pickup lifetime instead of expiring on the first world update.
  • Existing safeguards retained: Protected quest items cannot be dropped. Mobile confirmation, quest-fragment icons and equipment comparisons remain available.
  • Economy review, not a rate reset: Rarity, affix, reward and collection rates are unchanged. Real collection pacing and bag pressure remain playtest inputs.
  • Still open alpha: This release does not open closed beta. Full prior patch history is retained below.

Alpha 1.33.0 (builds that work together)

  • Single-specialization kits: Every class branch now has a reachable combo. Desktop and phone cards show specialization, unlock level and whether the skills are learned. Skill IDs, saved builds and equipment are preserved; no forced reset.
  • Wizard: Scorch Beam slows enemies and sets up five Arcane Missiles; Spell Focus adds a brief non-stacking ward. Time Warp refreshes your own Teleport and Gravity Well, not allies' cooldowns. Implosion also rewards hits on control-immune bosses. Pyromancer retains its area-pressure kit with Fireball → Flame Whip and Tornado → Cataclysm combos.
  • Fighter: Iron Fortress refreshes Shield Slam for a stronger counter. Grip damages and generates threat even when bosses cannot be pulled. Juggernaut now charges up to ten units before its shockwave. Rampage works at ordinary health for 2× Damage stat (3× below 30% HP); Berserker Edge → Rampage grants a non-stacking 20%-maximum-health ward.
  • Rogue: Mark → Backstab earns Ambush. Poison → aimed Tripwire doubles impact damage; Cloak → Smoke refreshes Tripwire at normal Smoke cost/cooldown, replacing the old discount. Coated Fan of Knives offers a brief spacing slow. Offline piercing Volley now hits successive targets and cancels pending shots after death or travel.
  • Cleric: Healing Light → Guardian Embrace protects the caster briefly; Ground → Radiant Strike doubles the strike without a cross-branch mark. Zeal refreshes your own Guardians and sets up their boosted variant. Purifying Wave retains its cleanse and gains a modest hostile holy pulse/slow that respects walls and immunity. Mass Revival still heals living allies only, not dead characters.
  • Clearer feedback and prices: Refresh effects immediately update the authoritative hotbar. Talent Master displayed reset prices now match the existing server charges; prices and refunds themselves are unchanged. Combo descriptions explain real benefits and limits.
  • Scoped verification: All twelve builds passed learned-skill/resource checks with class-appropriate Uncommon/Rare gear at five level checkpoints; focused mechanics and rendered checks are not proof of final balance or subjective feel. Slow field regeneration and town recovery remain intentional.
  • Still open alpha: This release does not open closed beta. Full prior patch history is retained below.

Alpha 1.32.0 (warnings that belong to your encounter)

  • Keep the useful instructions: Boss warnings retain their authored movement advice. Multi-circle attacks show all their boundaries but announce the warning once.
  • Your encounter only: Warnings retain their cast-time instance. Other dungeons and late warnings from an area you already left no longer overwrite local combat feedback.
  • Relevant overworld danger: Distant warnings outside the loaded area are ignored; large circles overlapping your area remain visible.
  • Stuns affect summons: Offline Seraphs cannot attack while stunned. Stun expiry restores attacks without extending summon lifetime or preventing owner-loss cleanup.
  • Mechanics preserved: No damage, radius, windup, stat scaling or reward changes. Focused warning, collision and summon checks do not replace real-player encounter feedback.
  • Still open alpha: This release does not open closed beta. Full prior patch history is retained below.

Alpha 1.31.0 (support that reaches living allies)

  • Choose a living ally: Healing Light and Divine Intervention cursor targeting skip disconnected and zero-health characters, matching explicit target eligibility. Unavailable allies no longer take priority over nearby living recipients.
  • Consistent support: Beacon and Mass Revival also skip unavailable bystanders. Ordinary healing does not resurrect; offline healing uses the same positive-health rule.
  • Vendor safety: Invalid empty-slot sale requests cannot create Gold. Normal sale values and existing balances are unchanged.
  • Class roles reviewed: Short prepared checks used class-appropriate Uncommon/Rare gear across level bands and a four-player tank/healer/DPS combat window. They are not a full dungeon clear or a human pacing measurement.
  • Recovery preserved: No damage, healing amount, mana cost, cooldown, gear, reward or stat-scaling changes. Slow field regeneration, town recovery and Well Rested remain intentional.
  • Still open alpha: Human sustained-role and balance feedback remains open. This release does not open closed beta. Full prior patch history is retained below.

Alpha 1.30.0 (remembering the journey)

  • Your journey so far: The Journal has a collapsed recap of personally completed milestones, including your latest recovered expedition account. Opening a dungeon road is not repairing its crystal; the recap keeps that distinction clear and points to the earned aftermath.
  • Only your discoveries: Ready-but-unclaimed objectives, another player's access and optional catch-up chapters do not imply other progress or reveal unseen accounts. The recap retains its open state and reading position through ordinary updates.
  • The right entrance: Ilyra's greeting and Nexus/finale quest text name Lanternhold's Dungeon Guide for private admission. The Fourfold Portal leads to the shared expedition, not Malachar's throne. Return to Ilyra and click Complete Quest personally.
  • Saved journeys preserved: Updated directions retain existing counts, quoted rewards and prior grants, including zero-Gold quotes. No new quest requirements, rewards, balance changes or save migration.
  • Still open alpha: Short graph, saved-contract and phone-layout checks do not replace human campaign and pacing feedback. This release does not open closed beta. Full prior patch history is retained below.

Alpha 1.29.0 (hear the four voices)

  • Hear the covenant: Eidolon aid has its own short-lived notice, independent of target changes and danger warnings. Full dialogue and effects remain in the Game log. Notices clear on death, disconnect and leaving the instance; reconnect does not invent a phase.
  • Readable on phones: A compact aid summary briefly uses the quest-tracker space, then restores your objectives. Your quests and tracking choices stay unchanged.
  • Four elemental cues: Brief stone, water, fire and air effects accompany received aid around living characters, with fewer motes on Low. These are airborne effects, not new ground hazards.
  • Prepare and claim personally: The Dungeon Guide explains all four interventions and your role. A ready finale directs you to Ilyra for Complete Quest and the rereadable epilogue. Aid is not invulnerability or resurrection; weekly cache eligibility stays separate.
  • An earned ending: The Journal requires your completed finale receipt before declaring victory. Finishing early chapters or having a ready but unclaimed quest is not the end of the story.
  • Still open alpha: No combat balance, reward or save changes. This presentation pass is not a new raid-clear or human pacing measurement and does not open closed beta. Full prior patch history is retained below.

Alpha 1.28.0 (the road through the Fifth Note)

  • The right door: Active Nexus and Dark King contracts point to the Dungeon Guide for private encounter admission, not the Fourfold Portal into the shared expedition. Inside the Dark Realm, directions explain recovery camp and Return to Lanternhold.
  • Three guardians ahead: Nexus preparation explains Dissonant Herald → Null Architect → Eidolon Devourer, the intervening chambers and MEMORY FRACTURE. Leave the marked circle before impact.
  • Your own Fifth Note: A cleared Nexus directs an accepted, unclaimed Fifth Note to Ilyra. Each character claims personally with Complete Quest; boss loot does not unlock the court. Veterans retain normal exit guidance.
  • Recovery retained: Continue returns to the latest cleared boss checkpoint in the same run. Existing eligibility, instance/logout expiry, encounters, rewards and saved contracts are unchanged.
  • Still open alpha: This is guidance and handoff polish, not a new campaign-timing measurement, raid clear or final art approval. It does not open closed beta. Full prior patch history is retained below.

Alpha 1.27.0 (finding your way through the expedition)

  • Find the camp’s people: Ilyra’s Resonant Projection, Artificer Maelin and Scout Ren are now independently searchable atlas destinations, even without a tracked quest. Ilyra explains personal Complete Quest claims and separate Gold and Resonance XP rewards; Maelin and Ren remain optional read-only conversations.
  • Know the road home: The Foothold explains recovery inside the lantern circle, Recall/Return to Lanternhold, and returning through the town portal or Guide. Each district describes its connected roads. Nexus field records are not a dungeon entrance; private admission remains with the Dungeon Guide. Straight-line waypoints are not safe paths.
  • District-specific objectives: Hunt markers name the correct level-100-or-higher enemies in the required district. Collection markers explain chance drops and physical pickup, not credit for kills alone. Saved instructions and discovery prerequisites remain intact; ready quests still require manual completion.
  • More map on landscape phones: On short landscape screens, scrollable directions sit beside the map instead of reducing it to a narrow strip. Portrait and desktop layouts stay unchanged, with existing waypoint and Close controls retained.
  • Preserved story and progress: The 24 expedition chapters, 38 discoveries, six witnesses, saved contracts, entry gates and rewards are unchanged. The intended 8–12-hour expedition remains for player pacing tests, not a measured claim. This release does not open closed beta. Full prior patch history is retained below.

Alpha 1.26.0 (the crystal is not the guardian)

  • Stay for the Vigil: Defeating the guardian does not restore the crystal. After a cleared assault, the tracker now keeps you with Maelin while the repair is pending instead of sending you out with your loot. A preparing ritual no longer displays a fictional first wave.
  • Prepare for your raid: Each unlocked elemental raid in the Dungeon Guide has a collapsible guardian, Vigil and rewards briefing. Read the boss warning, learn your realm’s repair task, and complete that task AND defeat every attacker in all three waves. Follow the live ground markings during combat.
  • Personal completion: Maelin channels the repair automatically; she is not a quest giver. After restoration, the compact tracker says “Return to Ilyra in town,” including on phones. Check your Chronicle and click Complete Quest with Ilyra for your ready repair quest. Each character claims personally; raid loot is separate.
  • Progress stays yours: Existing admission rules, recovery, saved progress and normal dungeon exits are preserved. No combat, XP, drop-rate, currency or save changes. Targeted snapshot and desktop/phone-sized UI checks cover the changed guidance without repeating full raids.
  • Continued open-alpha work: Real-party feedback, human campaign pacing and final modern-art approval remain open. This release does not open closed beta. Full prior patch history is retained below.

Alpha 1.25.0 (the Air journey)

  • Find the right Air creatures: Pinion guidance starts with nearer Storm Harpies beyond Earth’s eastern passage and explains chance drops and physical pickup. Hunts mark their actual sectors; the Thunder Roc hunt retains its level-80-or-higher requirement. Wind warnings remind you that a waypoint is not a safe path.
  • A readable Horizon Orrery: Three lower bevelled instrument rings, dial graduations, visible pivots and a small faceted core replace the cropped, overlapping hoops. The instrument fits normal framing, with its ground plinths and walking clearance unchanged.
  • The storm’s story stays intact: Selen’s journal, the Roc hunt, eight Pinions, the stationary-storm discoveries, level-70 Tempest admission and the separate Skyglass repair raid remain in order. Ready quests still require a personal conversation and claim with Ilyra. No XP, drop-rate, quest-count or gear changes.
  • Air combat review: Focused server checks confirm Wizard and Rogue projectile travel and hits at the entrance and far reaches. Separate desktop and portrait rendering checks show the Fireball above the ground at both locations. This is bounded regression evidence, not a full campaign replay or every-device guarantee.
  • Continued open-alpha work: Human pacing, actual-phone group play and final modern-art approval remain open. This release does not open closed beta. Full prior patch history is retained below.
